<summary>Agent, LLM and contribution guidelines.</summary>

If an agent or LLM was involved in generating this issue, please say so below, and note what it was used for. Autonomously-opened issues are not accepted: see our [policy on agents and LLMs](https://github.com/OpenDrift/opendrift/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#agents-llms-and-autonomously-written-code).

* PRs should try to stay short enough to be reviewable, solving one issue at the time.
* Communication and comments should stay brief and managable.
* We prefer human communication: using agentic text in communication with us (PR description, issue description) is not banned, but especially responses to text we would prefer humanly written text.
* The user submitting code and text is responsible for the content.

</details>

- [ ] I agree to follow the project's [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/OpenDrift/opendrift/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
